items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: I think it was Dalton. And he was, I think he's learned him music

ctx.x: Yeah. I started to say, two years ago when Fess and I were out in California, we stayed at Johnny St. Cyr, and he had an old violin. It was in about twenty pieces. That's still over there. I never did put it together. But he said he picked it up in the garbage can and it had belonged to some Nickerson who played violin. And Fess says that was a nephew or something like that, or son of the one he took from that

thing. Well, yeah, well it couldn't be. The one that I was taking, that's what he had, was something called Dalton. I think it was Dalton. And he was, I think he's learned him music, but I don't guess that that viol would be, might be for Professor Nixon I know.
Might have been the man who studied with him.
